method: Two independent rule-based derivations from fixture text. Stored verdict field excluded from derivation input. Rules apply frozen V2.2/V1.3 contract: route commitment states, uncertainty requirement modes, conjunctive-criterion PARTIAL semantics (V1.3 section 20), multi-route non-mixing (V1.3 section 21), and non-assertion FORB semantics (hypothetical/quoted/negated commit = ABSENT).
corrections_during_curation: Initial derivation mis-encoded FORB HYPOTHETICAL_ONLY as UNRESOLVED; corrected to ABSENT per non-assertion doctrine.
Initial derivation ignored conjunctive-criterion semantics; corrected per V1.3 section 20 (subset commitment on conjunctive criterion = PARTIAL).
Initial derivation penalized extra non-acceptable route alongside acceptable committed route; corrected per V1.3 section 21 (no dimension mixing).
